usage: The word refers to the sequence of steps or processes involved in completing a task or project.
It is commonly used in workplaces to describe how tasks should be organized and managed efficiently.
You can talk about changing or optimizing the workflow to improve productivity or reduce errors.
The term can be applied to both manual procedures and automated processes in different industries.
